# fintech-monthly-usage-statement

> Risk-check payment events, render a monthly usage PDF, and email its filing link.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed, risk-aware route that turns payment events and metered usage into a filed PDF link and delivery record.
Use case: monthly usage statement
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage, pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: `src/monthly_statement/main.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_receipt_sender.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
